title: CMHC Canada Housing Trust – Offering Circular Terms
description: JSON Schema for the key terms printed on a Canada Housing Trust offering circular. This is a terms/intake schema rather than a full transcription of the prospectus: it captures the cover-page economics, the recurring interest dates, the issuer/guarantor, and the security identifiers when the PDF prints them. Dates are ISO 8601 calendar dates and amounts/rates are numbers.

sourceUrl.description: URL or path the PDF was downloaded from, when known.

documentDate.description: Date printed at the top of the offering circular, e.g. 'Dated February 15, 2017' normalized to '2017-02-15'.

currency.description: Issue currency. All current circulars are Canadian dollars ('CAD').

aggregatePrincipalAmount.description: Aggregate principal amount of this issuance, e.g. C$2,500,000,000 becomes 2500000000.

coupon.description: The coupon described in the cover heading. Fixed-rate circulars print a percentage; floating-rate circulars state 'Floating Rate' and describe the index and spread in the body.

displayText.description: Printed coupon descriptor, e.g. '2.350%' or 'Floating Rate'.

fixedRatePercent.description: Fixed annual coupon rate in percent. Required when kind is 'fixed'.

index.description: Floating-rate index, e.g. '3 Month CDOR', 'CORRA' or 'Daily Compounded CORRA'. Required when kind is 'floating'.

spreadPercent.description: Spread over the index in percentage points. Basis-point values are divided by 100 (18.0 basis points becomes 0.18). Required when kind is 'floating'.

maturityDate.description: Maturity date printed in the cover heading, e.g. 'to mature June 15, 2027'.

issuePricePercent.description: Issue price as a percentage of principal, e.g. 99.702.

yieldPercent.description: Yield at date of issue in percent, when the cover states one. Floating-rate circulars and some re-openings omit it.

settlementDate.description: Delivery/settlement date printed as 'on or about ...'.

interestPaymentFrequency.description: Recurring interest payment frequency, normalized from 'Half-yearly' or 'quarterly'.

interestPaymentDates.description: Recurring month/day interest payment dates in printed order, e.g. ['June 15', 'December 15'].

minimumDenomination.description: Minimum denomination of the bonds, in the issue currency.

issuerName.description: Issuer name. All current circulars name Canada Housing Trust No. 1.

guarantorName.description: Guarantor name. All current circulars name Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation.

legalEntityIdentifier.description: Issuer Legal Entity Identifier, printed on newer circulars.

listingExchange.description: Exchange named in the listing application sentence, e.g. 'Luxembourg Stock Exchange'.

agency.description: Rating agency, e.g. 'Standard & Poor’s', 'Moody’s Investors Service' or 'DBRS Limited'.

rating.description: Rating assigned by the agency, e.g. 'AAA' or 'Aaa'.

ratings.description: Credit ratings stated on the cover.

cusip.description: Committee on Uniform Securities Identification Procedures number.
